title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 340 (Power of Tribunal to assess damages against delinquent directors, etc.)

content.overview: Where in the course of winding up it appears that any person who has taken part in the promotion or formation of the company, or any past or present director, manager, Company Liquidator or officer of the company, has misapplied or retained or become liable or accountable for any money or property of the company, or has been guilty of any misfeasance or breach of trust in relation to the company, the Tribunal may, on the application of the Official Liquidator, Company Liquidator, creditor or contributory, examine the conduct of that person and compel him to repay or restore the money or property or any part thereof with interest, or to contribute such sum to the assets of the company by way of compensation as the Tribunal thinks just.
content.glance: Tribunal may examine delinquent promoters/directors/managers/liquidators/officers and order repayment, restoration or compensatory contribution for misapplication, retention, misfeasance or breach of trust.
content.study: Section 340 is the misfeasance and breach-of-trust summary procedure. It applies to promoters and persons involved in formation, and to past or present directors, managers, Company Liquidators and officers. Where such a person has misapplied or retained company money or property, become liable or accountable for it, or committed misfeasance or breach of trust in relation to the company, the Tribunal may examine his conduct and order repayment or restoration of money or property (with interest) or a compensatory contribution to the assets. Application may be made by the Official Liquidator, Company Liquidator, a creditor or a contributory. The section is remedial and may operate alongside other civil or criminal liability.

sections.heading: Persons covered
sections.body: Promoters/formation participants; past or present directors, managers, Company Liquidators, officers.

sections.heading: Conduct and remedies
sections.body: Misapplication, retention, accountability, misfeasance or breach of trust — Tribunal may order repayment, restoration (with interest) or compensatory contribution.

provisions.title: Power of Tribunal to assess damages against delinquent directors, etc.

examples.title: Misapplied funds
examples.body: A former director diverted company funds for personal use. On application by the Company Liquidator the Tribunal under s. 340 examines the conduct and orders repayment with interest to the estate.

hypotheticals.question: Is s. 340 limited to current directors?
hypotheticals.analysis: No. It covers past or present directors, managers, Company Liquidators and officers, and also persons who took part in promotion or formation.

rows.left: Power of Tribunal to assess damages against delinquent directors, etc.

misconceptions.trap: s. 340 is only a criminal provision.
misconceptions.correction: It is a civil/remedial summary procedure for repayment, restoration or compensation; it may coexist with criminal liability.

questionsAndAnswers.question: How should a Section 340 problem be analysed?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: I. State the rule of s. 340. II. Apply to facts. III. Conclude.
